purpose: CS336 counterexample transfer: first natural author delivery on unseen tasks, using existing RSI/SE8 flow

authorization.user_scope: User authorized local same-model old/new heldout comparison; no production changes
authorization.limit_origin: Internal execution cap chosen for this experiment; not a user-specified amount
authorization.pricing: Peak upper estimate: cache hit 0.04, cache miss 2, output 8 CNY per million; reserve worst case before each request

model.limits: Preserve frozen production per-request limits: Author 131072, ordinary author-unavailable chat 32768, unset auxiliary relay default 16384
model.served_model: Record actual provider response for every call

arms.A: Frozen current catalog revision 5; 9 method IDs, 10 versions
arms.B: Same code and existing methods; catalog revision 6 adds chart-reveal@3 selection cue, counterexample, runnable teacher example, adaptation and checks

isolation.author_input: Identical input per task; no evaluator-only notes, no prior outputs or human fixes
isolation.method_selection: Natural read_method selection; never force candidate reads or seed method_refs
isolation.teaching_review: Tutor observing fixture; no active teaching-review loop; ordinary Author preview and delivery checks remain
isolation.production: No deployment, no production workspace writes

outcomes.primary: First successful delivery within the initial natural user turn; normal self-preview and patch allowed
outcomes.also_archive: First write, all public tool calls/results, actual observed method reads, declared refs, first and final delivered versions, failures and usage
outcomes.failure_policy: No replacement or hidden retry. Ordinary generation failures retained; provider/budget/usage/timeout stops retain unstarted runs
outcomes.evaluation: Read actual rendered page and operate task controls against independent mathematical expectations. Judge whether objects/denominators are explained, one state connects diagrams and exact values, comparison is accurate, and reading route is coherent. Render 960x720,320x420,640x240. Preserve full derivation and lookup where useful. No automatic score or fixed short-video layout requirement
outcomes.decision: Candidate adoption requires observed transfer without material correctness or interaction regressions. No reads means natural uptake unproven; better appearance alone does not establish cause. Small batch is directional evidence only
